description: This file defines the TypeNameGrainPropertiesProvider class, which populates properties related to grain types and interfaces in Orleans. It implements methods to populate property dictionaries with type names, full type names, formatted runtime type names, and assembly names for grains and grain interfaces.

classes.name: TypeNameGrainPropertiesProvider
classes.description: A class that populates grain and grain interface property dictionaries with type information, implementing IGrainPropertiesProvider and IGrainInterfacePropertiesProvider interfaces.

methods.name: Populate (grain class)
methods.description: Populates properties dictionary with the grain class's name, full name, formatted type name, and assembly name.

methods.name: Populate (interface type)
methods.description: Populates properties dictionary with the interface type's name, formatted type name, and assembly name.
